title: Implement invoice PDF export
body:
## Caveman
- **Problem:** Users cannot download invoices.
- **Do this:** Add PDF export endpoint.
- **Done when:** GET /invoices/:id/pdf returns a PDF.

## Files to change
| Path | Why | Confidence |
| src/invoices/pdf.ts | generate PDF | likely |

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Given invoice id, when GET pdf, then application/pdf

title: Add Stripe webhook signature check
body:
## Caveman

title: Fix timezone on invoice dates
body:
## Caveman
- **Problem:** Dates show UTC only.
- **Do this:** Format in account TZ.
- **Done when:** UI shows local date.

## Files to change
| Path | Why | Confidence |
| src/dates.ts | formatting | likely |

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Invoice date matches account timezone

title: Add rate limit to public quote API
body:
## Caveman
- **Problem:** Quote API can be scraped.
- **Do this:** 60 req/min per IP.
- **Done when:** 429 after limit.

## Files to change
| Path | Why | Confidence |
| src/middleware/rateLimit.ts | limiter | likely |

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] 61st request in a minute returns 429
